edits.old: The plan-cache README identifies single-solution and rooted `$or` plans as pinned examples in the SBE cache. Pinned entries lack ordinary `works` or `reads` feedback and bypass the normal read-budget trial, although standard cache eviction can still remove them. The pinned `cached_planner.cpp` path checks whether a cached foreign `$lookup` hash join remains eligible before `attemptToUsePlan` checks `decisionReads` for the pinned-entry bypass; if that join is no longer eligible, the planner replans immediately. The sources therefore support skipping threshold-based cached-plan validation for pinned entries, but not a guarantee that every replan path is bypassed. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-20)

If the join is no longer eligible, the planner replans immediately without a trial. So the pinned bypass skips only the read-budget trial, not every replan path.
